summary: The L0/L1/L2 direction is sound, but /wc still has an ambiguous pre-claim loading contract: fast-path text says minimum L0 then claim, while LOAD FIRST broadly enumerates meta-context before role specialization. Runtime evidence shows bounded receipts can preserve critical laws, while strategic receipt enforcement remains inconsistent. Context Fabric Lite P1 is already the correct implementation candidate and passed its isolated tests, but live role-conditioned automated selection and repository-wide efficiency are not proven. Route change: make PRECLAIM_MIN -> ROLE_EXPAND explicit and close the existing live Context Fabric canary boundary rather than adding more prose or a second context architecture.
route_delta: Explicit two-stage context loading: PRECLAIM_MIN then role-conditioned ROLE_EXPAND.
Enforce structured selection-provenance receipts for every material run; strategic/integration roles fail verification when missing required context receipt.
Use Context Fabric Lite P1 as the sole context implementation candidate; do not create a duplicate subsystem.
Run a pinned live-repository canary across narrow and strategic role profiles with correctness first, then measured file/token/tool-call reduction.
Prefer compact derived frontier projections plus exact drill-down over raw all-queue/all-run scans.

next_work_candidate.relationship: successor canary to Context Fabric Lite P1 and prior Context Receipt canary

post_return.boundary: Fresh strategic-critic gates should be taken by a fresh independent critic, not automatically chained from this context critic.
